entry.title: New: RES26-254 (Honolulu) — INTRO
entry.content:
ACCEPTING A GIFT FROM THE HONOLULU ZOOLOGICAL SOCIETY TO THE CITY, VALUED AT $2,677, FOR THE REGISTRATION, ACCOMMODATION, AND AIRFARE EXPENSES FOR BRIAN JUOZATIS (HONOLULU ZOO VETERINARY TECHNICIAN) TO ATTEND THE ASSOCIATION OF ZOO VETERINARY TECHNICIANS CONFERENCE FOR CONTINUING EDUCATION AND PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT IN NASHVILLE, TENNESSEE, FROM SEPTEMBER 25-30, 2026.

Latest action: Introduced.
